data.title: 空弦 · 钟声之后
data.description: 钟声停后，她侧过头问你要不要再待一会儿。风吹得她靠近了些，她却只是笑着继续看你。
data.action: 倚栏侧头，靠近镜头轻声交谈
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: High on a breezy rooftop terrace under a vast, star-studded night sky, Archetto leans closely against the metal railing, offering a warm, inviting smile to the viewer. The distant, shimmering city lights create a beautiful bokeh effect in the background, while soft, ambient side-lighting gently contours her features, highlighting her intimate expression and the peaceful, nocturnal atmosphere of the terrace.
